title: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2 Reveals Opening Song in New Trailer
content: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2 anime revealed the second trailer, introducing the opening theme song “nekojarashi” by 7co. The second season was announced on March 29, and it is set to premiere on July 5, 2026. Studio Lapin Track ( Undead Girl Murder Farce ) is animating. You can watch the new trailer below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess TV Anime Reveals July 12 Debut, New Visual
content: The staff for the television anime of Satsuki Nakamura 's Though I Am an Inept Villainess ( Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga - Sūgū Chōso Torikae Den ) light novel series revealed a new visual and the show's July 12 debut on Monday. The anime will debut on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on July 12 at 11:45 p.m.
author: ANN

title: 'Historie' Unveils Main Cast, First Promo, January 2027 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Historie manga revealed the main cast, teaser visual (pictured right), and the first promotional video on Sunday. Produced by LIDENFILMS , the anime will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne Anime Reveals 2 New Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Tanba and Yuunagi 's The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne ( Saikyō Degarashi Ōji no Anyaku Teii Arasoi: Munō o Enjiru SS-Rank Ōji wa Kōi Keishō-sen o Kage kara Shihai Suru ) light novel series revealed two additional cast members on Monday.
author: ANN

title: You and I Are Polar Opposites 2nd Season Anime Unveils Theme Song Artist in New Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Kōcha Agasawa 's romantic comedy manga You and I Are Polar Opposites ( Seihantaina Kimi to Boku ) revealed the second season's new promotional video, opening theme song artist, and additional new staff members on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Saikyou Degarashi Ouji no Anyaku Teii Arasoi' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tanba 's Saikyou Degarashi Ouji no Anyaku Teii Arasoi: Munou wo Enjiru SS Rank Ouji wa Koui Keishousen wo Kage kara Shihai suru ( The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for the Throne ) light novel announced a supporting pair of cast on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Needy Girl Overdose Anime Streams 'Next Chapter' Promo Video
content: The official website for the television anime of WSS (Why So Serious) Playground and Xemono's Needy Girl Overdose game (known as Needy Streamer Overload in English on Steam ) revealed a "Next Chapter" promotional video on Sunday. The video features the song "INTERNET YAMERO" by Aiobahn +81 , from the original game.
author: ANN

title: Street Fighter 6 Game Previews DLC Character Ingrid in New Character Guide Video
content: The official Street Fighter YouTube channel revealed a new video on Friday for the Street Fighter 6 game previewing DLC character Ingrid's moveset. The game added Sagat on August 5, the first character in the Year 3 Character Pass. C. Viper, the second character in the pass, debuted on October 15.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves Game Adds Mr. Karate DLC Character on May 27
content: SNK revealed on Sunday that it will add the DLC character Mr. Karate to the Fatal Fury City of the Wolves fighting game on May 27. The character is part of the game's Season Pass 2. English character trailer Japanese character trailer Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for Season Pass 2, launched on January 22.
author: ANN

title: Uso Tantei Tomanto Anime Casts Natsuki Hanae as Lemonade
content: The staff for the Uso Tantei Tomanto (Lie Detective Tomanto) short anime series announced on Monday that Natsuki Hanae will join the cast of the anime's "updated" version as the ace detective Lemonade.
author: ANN
